v1.0 JSON Schemas Explorer

Browse and link directly to every canonical JSON Schema in A2UI v1.0 (Candidate), read at build time from specification/v1_0/json/ and catalogs/. Select a schema file or definition to inspect its source lines and copy a #<schema-file>/<json-pointer> permalink, or switch to the v0.9.1 (Active) or v0.8 (Legacy) schemas.

A2UI Renderer Data Model Schema

22 lines

Schema for conveying the renderer data models for all active surfaces. This is used for bidirectional data synchronization between the renderer and the agent.

A2UI MCP Catalog

195 lines

A2UI catalog for Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. It defines the `callMcpTool` function, the `updateDataModel` function that writes values to the surface data model, and the `McpApp` component that renders a sandboxed MCP App connected to the host through the MCP Apps bridge.

Source: catalogs/mcp/v1/catalog.json ↗
Raw JSON ↗
$id https://a2ui.org/specification/v1_0/catalogs/mcp/catalog.json

A2UI Agent Capabilities Schema

26 lines

A schema for the agent capabilities object, which is used by an A2UI Agent to advertise its supported UI features to renderers. This can be embedded in an Agent Card for A2A or used in other transport protocols like MCP.

Source: specification/v1_0/json/agent_capabilities.json ↗
Raw JSON ↗
$id https://a2ui.org/specification/v1_0/agent_capabilities.json

A2UI Renderer Capabilities Schema

29 lines

A schema for the a2uiRendererCapabilities object, which is sent from the renderer to the agent as part of the A2A metadata to describe the renderer's UI rendering capabilities.

Source: specification/v1_0/json/renderer_capabilities.json ↗
Raw JSON ↗
$id https://a2ui.org/specification/v1_0/renderer_capabilities.json
